render_minecraft_house_view: run render_3x.py with an npy_p2b file and output directory to render a Minecraft house view as a PNG image
convert_yaw_pitch_to_unit_vector: use to_unit_vec to convert yaw and pitch angles in degrees to a 3D unit vector for camera positioning
find_ground_height_in_schematic: use ground_height to detect the ground level in a Minecraft block array by finding the layer with the highest dirt block concentration
render_schematic_with_cuberite: use the render function to load a schematic NPY file, place blocks in a Cuberite server, and generate a rendered PNG view
run_render_cli: run render_3x.py from the command line with an npy_p2b path and --out-dir to render a Minecraft house at a specified yaw and distance
